title: Case 010: Second Property Owner
initial_request: I already have a policy for my first flat and would like a separate quote for my other home at 110 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 1ZZ.
overview: Callum Price told Holly at Rowanfield Risk that he wanted a quote for a second property, while confirming that his first flat already had a policy. Holly requested the new property's address, type, use and desired start date; Callum supplied those details. Holly submitted a separate quotation request to Alderwick Underwriting, which confirmed that the request had been registered.

next_action.summary: Gather any further property or underwriting details needed for the separate quotation, and do not add the property to Callum's existing flat policy automatically.

outcome: A separate quotation request for the second property was registered by Alderwick Underwriting.

events.body: I already have a policy for my first flat, but I also have another home and would like to find out what it would cost to insure that separately. I can send you the details once I know what you need.
I can make a separate quotation enquiry for the other property. Please send its full address, property type, how it is used and when you would like cover to start.

The address is 110 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 1ZZ; it is a semi-detached house used as my own residence, not let to tenants. Please quote on the basis of a requested start date of 1 June 2025. I will not treat that requested date as cover starting unless I accept terms and the insurer confirms them.

Please register a separate quotation request for Callum Price's second property at 110 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 1ZZ. It is a semi-detached house used as his own residence, with a requested start of 1 June 2025 (subject to his acceptance and insurer confirmation); this request is not an instruction to amend his existing flat policy.
We have registered the separate quotation request for 110 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 1ZZ. This confirms receipt of the enquiry only and does not confirm or add insurance cover.
